transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... I'm just tired all the time. Um, by midmorning at work, even if I've just been reviewing some files or... walking a junior adjuster through a claim, I just... it feels like my body and my brain are already running on empty.
How long have you been feeling this tired?

A while. Um... a little over three years, I think. Maybe three years and three months. It kind of started when they... moved me into a different role at work. Just taking on more responsibility, mentoring the other adjusters and... overseeing the new workflow systems. So, yeah. Since then.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed since you started feeling tired?

I suppose so. Um... most days, it just feels like... there's this gray film over everything. Even when my husband tries to be nice, or... if we're cooking together with the family. I just kind of... go through the motions. I don't really feel it.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I don't really know. Um... I guess I haven't really thought about it. I mostly just work and come home now, so... I'm not sure.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but no longer find pleasure in?

Um... I used to paint a little. And, uh, hike. Sometimes I'd volunteer. But... I don't really do any of that anymore. I'm just... trying to get through the week, mostly. Even at work, I'm... missing things in the audits. Taking longer to sign off on files. It's just... hard to keep up.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I guess so. Um... like I said, I just don't really do them anymore. I haven't really thought about whether I miss them or not. I'm just... tired.
Do you feel like you no longer get pleasure from things that used to make you happy?

I... I don't really know how else to answer that. Like I said, I just don't do those things right now. So I couldn't tell you if they'd make me happy or not anymore. I just... I don't have the energy to find out.
Have you had any periods in the past three years where you felt like your normal self again?
No. Not really. It's just... been like this.
Have you had any periods where your sadness or depression was significantly worse than it is now?
I don't think so. It's just... it's always just been this kind of steady low. I don't really remember it being worse, but... it hasn't been better, either. Just the same.
Are you usually tired and feeling down most of the day, or does it come and go?

It doesn't really come and go. It's... most days. It just feels like there's a... a gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or... if we're cooking with the family. I just go through the motions. I don't really feel it like I used to.
Have you had two or more years where you felt this low and tired?

Yes. It's been... over two years. About three years and three months, I guess. It started around the time I was... moved into a higher-responsibility role at work. Mentoring the other adjusters and... overseeing the new workflow systems. It's just been since then.
Have you felt this way, with the gray film over everything, for most of every day over the past three years?
I suppose so. It's... hard to remember every single day, but... yes. Pretty much.
Have you noticed any changes in your feelings of sadness or tiredness over the past three years?
No, not really. It's... just been about the same.
Have you had any periods of at least two months where you didn't feel this low and tired?
No. I don't... I don't think so. It's just been pretty constant.
Have you had any periods where you felt significantly better for at least two months at a time since you started feeling this way?
No... like I said, it hasn't really lifted. Not for that long, anyway.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed most of the day?
I don't really know. It's... it's just always there. I don't really break it down into weeks. It all just kind of blends together.
Do you feel like you no longer enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable, or is it just that you don't have the energy to do them?

I suppose it's the enjoyment. It's... most days I just feel like there's a gray film over everything. Even if my husband is being kind, or... or we're cooking with the family. I can go through the motions, I just... I don't really feel the enjoyment I used to.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling this low and tired in the past three years?
I wouldn't really call them episodes. It's... it's just been one long stretch, I guess. I don't remember it ever really stopping.
Have you ever felt completely back to normal between periods of feeling low and tired?
No... I don't think so. Like I said, it doesn't really stop, so... no. I haven't.
Have you ever felt this low and tired before the role change at work?

No... I don't think so. It really started right around then. I guess it's been about three years and three months now. Ever since they moved me into that new role... having to mentor the other adjusters and oversee the new workflow systems. It just started then.
